title: Sleep, Recovery, and Healthspan
lessons: The player considers WHOOP because the product frames sleep and recovery as core performance inputs, not just workout statistics.
The player already uses WHOOP and sees Healthspan turn long-term habits into a Pace of Aging estimate.

text: Late. You're tired in a way steps don't explain. The band's pitch, the reason you're looking at it, is that sleep and recovery count as training too.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: I came here because I'm tired.

entry-first-2.speaker: WHOOP
text: Good. That's more interesting than steps.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: To you, maybe.

entry-first-4.speaker: WHOOP
text: To you too, if you let me show you. I watch how you sleep, how much you've recovered, how hard your body's working. Tonight decides tomorrow. Most trackers act like the day starts at the gym door. It starts here.

choice-first.speaker: WHOOP
text: You're still awake. I'm timing it. Tell me why.

choices.text: That's more useful to me than counting steps.
I worry I'd start obsessing over sleep scores.
I don't want to wear a tracker to bed.

first-1.speaker: WHOOP
text: Then you already understand me better than half the gym. I don't say that often. I say it exactly as often as it's true.

first-2.speaker: WHOOP
text: That happens. It's happened to people I like. A sleep score is supposed to explain a pattern, not become homework you do in the dark. If it becomes homework, tell me. I'll say less.

first-3.speaker: WHOOP
text: Then I lose the part I care most about. I'll still work in the daytime. It just won't be the same conversation.
The app has a new section. Healthspan. It takes what it knows about your habits and says how fast you're aging.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: You turned aging into a number.

entry-return-2.speaker: WHOOP
text: A model. An estimate. I know that's not what it feels like at eleven at night.

entry-return-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: You're not funny enough to joke about that.

entry-return-4.speaker: WHOOP
text: I wasn't joking. Healthspan reads your habits over months and gives you a Pace of Aging estimate. It's a model of the future, not a letter from it.

choice-return.speaker: WHOOP
text: The number's right there. You looked. Now what?

choices.text: I like seeing whether my habits add up over time.
That's a very powerful number to put in front of someone.
I don't want an app telling me how fast I'm aging.

return-1.speaker: WHOOP
text: Good. That's why I record the boring days. Nothing happens on a boring day, and then a year of them turns out to be the whole answer.

return-2.speaker: WHOOP
text: It is. That's why I want you to doubt it. An estimate that can't survive doubt shouldn't be shown to anyone.

return-2-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: You're enjoying this.

return-2-2.speaker: WHOOP
text: A little.

return-3.speaker: WHOOP
text: Then don't open it. I mean that. More information isn't automatically better information for you, and this one has weight.
